summary: Implementation of migration architecture from PostgreSQL to MongoDB with dual-write and CDC synchronization. Includes API layer updates for feature flag-based read/write routing, MongoDB schema design, validation parity utilities, and rollback endpoint for zero-downtime migration.

code_files.description: Controller implementing customer read/write logic with feature flag-controlled source selection and dual-write capability.
Service to handle transactional dual writes to PostgreSQL and MongoDB ensuring data consistency.
Handles PostgreSQL read/write operations using pg client.
Handles MongoDB read/write operations for flexible country-specific schema.
Feature flag utility integrating with LaunchDarkly for zero-downtime rollout control.
Controller for migration validation progress and rollback triggers.
Validation service for data parity check between PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

setup_instructions: Configure LaunchDarkly SDK Key and database URIs in .env
Ensure AWS DMS CDC connector is active before dual-write
